description:
Poppins, Inc. is redefining pediatric care for today's working families, and they are seeking a part-time Marketing Manager to join their team. The role focuses on executing marketing initiatives through content creation, campaign execution, and project management across various channels.

Own and manage Poppins' content calendar across multiple marketing channels

Create compelling content for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, blogs, and other digital channels

Develop SEO-driven articles and educational resources that drive organic traffic

Create and execute email nurture campaigns and newsletters to engage prospects and customers throughout the customer journey

Repurpose webinars, founder insights, customer stories, research, and clinical expertise into engaging marketing assets

Create tailored content for multiple stakeholder audiences, including: parents and caregivers, pediatricians and healthcare providers, daycares and preschools, employers and HR leaders, and employee benefits brokers and consultants

Coordinate with internal clinical experts and leadership to ensure all content is accurate, evidence-based, and aligned with the Poppins brand

Monitor marketing performance and recommend optimizations based on analytics

Support product launches, campaigns, webinars, white papers, sales collateral, and thought leadership initiatives

Help ensure a consistent, authentic brand voice across every customer touchpoint
